answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 22786 Country: India Title: I want to know that is it necessary to use some prefix or Suffix In name "Ali", Like "Mohammad" or "Abdul" or "Murtaza". Can a Boy be just Named "Ali". And is the name "Azaa" permissible In Islam for a Girl,what is its proper meaning? Question: I want to know that is it necessary to use some prefix or Suffix In name "Ali", Like "Mohammad" or "Abdul" or "Murtaza". Can a Boy be just Named "Ali". And is the name "Azaa" permissible In Islam for a Girl,what is its proper meaning? Answer ID: 22786 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1167/891/H=1431) (1) Only the name Ali is better as well. (2) To name a girl Azaa is also correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
